verdict.rationale: The evidence shows received registered-agent mail is scanned and uploaded to cloud storage, with email alerts and a personalized dashboard (legalzoom-docs-4, docs-9, docs-25). All of that is human-facing access. Nothing documents an API, webhook, or other machine interface an agent could use to retrieve documents or their metadata. The llms.txt probe is crawler guidance, not a document-retrieval interface, so it earns no credit.
